title: /hima status prints every meter of a running Campaign against its bound, in the numbers the run row holds
/hima status says which loop a Run is inside and how far into it, and /hima pack check refuses a drill-down that cannot be executed
/hima pack check refuses a drill-down whose edges the engine could never take, and a graph that says twice where its runs wait
/hima status says which fork a Run is inside and lists its branches with what each one is doing
/hima pack check refuses a fork the engine could never drive: a judge node inside a branch, two joins, an explore node after the join, and a fork inside a loop
/hima status says which generation of how many a Campaign reached, and /hima pack check refuses a Loop that cannot be executed
/hima status says the goal and the strategy in the pack's words, and /hima pack check refuses a word for a name the pack does not use
/hima run sets a knob by name with --set, refuses a value the declaration does not allow, and /hima status says every knob in the pack's words
a contract declaring no strategy knob at all is refused when the pack is loaded, in the contract schema's own words
/hima pack check holds a chooser's knobs and a pack's words against the contract's own declaration, before a Campaign exists
